angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 542,646 km at 60.31 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.5816 +/- 0.0162 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 60.31 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.78 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Alqasim et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-757 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract): 542,646 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.8 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Alqasim et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-757 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5278 +/- 63 K from Alqasim et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-757 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Alqasim et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-757 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-757.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.557, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-757 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 V, from Alqasim et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-34 8236: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-757 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.27 dex, from Alqasim et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-757 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.37675, from Alqasim et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-757 (pscomppars): age 7.5 Gyr, from Alqasim et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.533....1A/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/AJ/155/39/table6 (Variability properties of TIC sources with KELT), column Prot: 14.1864 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.78 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.863. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.
